Inna awlan-nāsi biʾibrāhīma lalladhīnattabaʿūhu wahādhan-nabiyyu wal-ladhīna āmanū, wallāhu waliyyul-muʾminīn
Waddaṭ ṭāʾifatum min ahlil-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum, wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūn
Yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna biʾāyātillāhi waʾantum tashhadūn
Yā ahlal-kitābi lima talbisūnal-ḥaqqa bil-bāṭili wataktumūnal-ḥaqqa waʾantum taʿlamūn
Waqālaṭ ṭāʾifatum min ahlil-kitābi āminū bil-ladhī unzila ʿalal-ladhīna āmanū wajhan-nahāri wakfurū ākhirahū laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
Walā tuʾminū illā liman tabiʿa dīnakum, qul innal-hudā hudallāhi ay yuʾtā aḥadum mithla mā ūtītum aw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum, qul innal-faḍla biyadillāh, yuʾtīhi may yashāʾ, wallāhu wāsiʿun ʿalīm
Yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihī may yashāʾ, wallāhu dhul-faḍlil-ʿaẓīm

Wamin ahlil-kitābi man in taʾmanhu biqinṭāriy yuʾaddihī ilayk, waminhum man in taʾmanhu bidīnāril lā yuʾaddihī ilayka illā mā dumta ʿalayhi qāʾimā, dhālika biʾannahum qālū laysa ʿalaynā fil-ummiyyīna sabīl, wayaqūlūna ʿalallāhil-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūn
Balā man awfā biʿahdihī wattaqā faʾinnallāha yuḥibbul-muttaqīn

Innal-ladhīna yashtarūna biʿahdillāhi waʾaymānihim thamanan qalīlan ulāʾika lā khalāqa lahum fil-ākhirati walā yukallimuhumullāhu walā yanẓuru ilayhim yawmal-qiyāmati walā yuzakkīhim, walahum ʿadhābun alīm

Waʾinna minhum lafarīqay yalwūna alsinatahum bil-kitābi litaḥsabūhu minal-kitābi wamā huwa minal-kitāb, wayaqūlūna huwa min ʿindillāhi wamā huwa min ʿindillāh, wayaqūlūna ʿalallāhil-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūn

Mā kāna libasharin ay yuʾtiyahullāhul-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqūla lin-nāsi kūnū ʿibādal lī min dūnillāhi walākin kūnū rabbāniyyīna bimā kuntum tuʿallimūnal-kitāba wabimā kuntum tadrusūn
Walā yaʾmurakum an tattakhidhul-malāʾikata wan-nabiyyīna arbābā, ayaʾmurukum bil-kufri baʿda idh antum muslimūn

Waʾidh akhadhallāhu mīthāqan-nabiyyīna lamā ātaytukum min kitābiw waḥikmatin thumma jāʾakum rasūlum muṣaddiqul limā maʿakum latuʾminunna bihī walatanṣurunnah, qāla aʾaqrartum waʾakhadhtum ʿalā dhālikum iṣrī, qālū aqrarnā, qāla fashhadū waʾana maʿakum minash-shāhidīn
Faman tawallā baʿda dhālika faʾulāʾika humul-fāsiqūn
Afaghayra dīnillāhi yabghūna walahū aslama man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭawʿaw wakarhaw waʾilayhi yurjaʿūn

Qul āmannā billāhi wamā unzila ʿalaynā wamā unzila ʿalā ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla waʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi wamā ūtiya mūsā waʿīsā wan-nabiyyūna mir rabbihim, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadim minhum, wanaḥnu lahū muslimūn
Wamay yabtaghi ghayral-islāmi dīnan falay yuqbala minh, wahuwa fil-ākhirati minal-khāsirīn
Kayfa yahdillāhu qawman kafarū baʿda īmānihim washahidū annar-rasūla ḥaqquw wajāʾahumul-bayyināt, wallāhu lā yahdil-qawmaẓ-ẓālimīn
Ulāʾika jazāʾuhum anna ʿalayhim laʿnatallāhi wal-malāʾikati wan-nāsi ajmaʿīn
Khālidīna fīhā, lā yukhaffafu ʿanhumul-ʿadhābu walā hum yunẓarūn
Illal-ladhīna tābū mim baʿdi dhālika waʾaṣlaḥū, faʾinnallāha ghafūrur raḥīm
Innal-ladhīna kafarū baʿda īmānihim thummazdādū kufral lan tuqbala tawbatuhum, waʾulāʾika humuḍ-ḍāllūn
Innal-ladhīna kafarū wamātū wahum kuffārun falay yuqbala min aḥadihim milʾul-arḍi dhahabaw walawiftadā bih, ulāʾika lahum ʿadhābun alīmuw wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
Lan tanālul-birra ḥattā tunfiqū mimmā tuḥibbūn, wamā tunfiqū min shayʾin faʾinnallāha bihī ʿalīm
Kulluṭ-ṭaʿāmi kāna ḥillal libanī isrāʾīla illā mā ḥarrama isrāʾīlu ʿalā nafsihī min qabli an tunazzalat-tawrāh, qul faʾtū bit-tawrāti fatlūhā in kuntum ṣādiqīn
Famaniftarā ʿalallāhil-kadhiba mim baʿdi dhālika faʾulāʾika humuẓ-ẓālimūn
Qul ṣadaqallāh, fattabiʿū millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā, wamā kāna minal-mushrikīn
Inna awwala baytiw wuḍiʿa lin-nāsi lalladhī bibakkata mubārakaw wahudal lil-ʿālamīn
Fīhi āyātum bayyinātum maqāmu ibrāhīm, waman dakhalahū kāna āminā, walillāhi ʿalan-nāsi ḥijjul-bayti manistaṭāʿa ilayhi sabīlā, waman kafara faʾinnallāha ghaniyyun ʿanil-ʿālamīn
Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna biʾāyātillāhi wallāhu shahīdun ʿalā mā taʿmalūn
Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima taṣuddūna ʿan sabīlillāhi man āmana tabghūnahā ʿiwajaw waʾantum shuhadāʾ, wamallāhu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū in tuṭīʿū farīqam minal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba yaruddūkum baʿda īmānikum kāfirīn
Wakayfa takfurūna waʾantum tutlā ʿalaykum āyātullāhi wafīkum rasūluh, wamay yaʿtaṣim billāhi faqad hudiya ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanuttaqullāha ḥaqqa tuqātihī walā tamūtunna illā waʾantum muslimūn

Waʿtaṣimū biḥablillāhi jamīʿaw walā tafarraqū, wadhkurū niʿmatallāhi ʿalaykum idh kuntum aʿdāʾan faʾallafa bayna qulūbikum faʾaṣbaḥtum biniʿmatihī ikhwānā, wakuntum ʿalā shafā ḥufratim minan-nāri faʾanqadhakum minhā, kadhālika yubayyinullāhu lakum āyātihī laʿallakum tahtadūn
Waltakum minkum ummatuy yadʿūna ilal-khayri wayaʾmurūna bil-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿanil-munkar, waʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn
Walā takūnū kal-ladhīna tafarraqū wakhtalafū mim baʿdi mā jāʾahumul-bayyināt, waʾulāʾika lahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm
Yawma tabyaḍḍu wujūhuw wataswaddu wujūh, faʾammal-ladhīnaswaddat wujūhuhum, akafartum baʿda īmānikum fadhūqul-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
Waʾammal-ladhīnabyaḍḍat wujūhuhum fafī raḥmatillāh, hum fīhā khālidūn
Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqq, wamallāhu yurīdu ẓulmal lil-ʿālamīn
Walillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, waʾilallāhi turjaʿul-umūr
Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat lin-nāsi taʾmurūna bil-maʿrūfi watanhawna ʿanil-munkari watuʾminūna billāh, walaw āmana ahlul-kitābi lakāna khayral lahum, minhumul-muʾminūna waʾaktharuhumul-fāsiqūn
Lay yaḍurrūkum illā adhā, waʾiy yuqātilūkum yuwallūkumul-adbār, thumma lā yunṣarūn

Ḍuribat ʿalayhimudh-dhillatu ayna mā thuqifū illā biḥablim minallāhi waḥablim minan-nāsi wabāʾū bighaḍabim minallāhi waḍuribat ʿalayhimul-maskanah, dhālika biʾannahum kānū yakfurūna biʾāyātillāhi wayaqtulūnal-anbiyāʾa bighayri ḥaqq, dhālika bimā ʿaṣaw wakānū yaʿtadūn
Laysū sawāʾā, min ahlil-kitābi ummatun qāʾimatuy yatlūna āyātillāhi ānāʾal-layli wahum yasjudūn
Yuʾminūna billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhiri wayaʾmurūna bil-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿanil-munkari wayusāriʿūna fil-khayrāt, waʾulāʾika minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn
Wamā yafʿalū min khayrin falay yukfarūh, wallāhu ʿalīmum bil-muttaqīn
Innal-ladhīna kafarū lan tughniya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum minallāhi shayʾā, waʾulāʾika aṣḥābun-nār, hum fīhā khālidūn
Mathalu mā yunfiqūna fī hādhihil-ḥayātid-dunyā kamathali rīḥin fīhā ṣirrun aṣābat ḥartha qawmin ẓalamū anfusahum faʾahlakath, wamā ẓalamahumullāhu walākin anfusahum yaẓlimūn

Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū biṭānatam min dūnikum lā yaʾlūnakum khabālā, waddū mā ʿanittum, qad badatil-baghḍāʾu min afwāhihim, wamā tukhfī ṣudūruhum akbar, qad bayyannā lakumul-āyāti in kuntum taʿqilūn

Hāʾantum ulāʾi tuḥibbūnahum walā yuḥibbūnakum watuʾminūna bil-kitābi kullih, waʾidhā laqūkum qālū āmannā, waʾidhā khalaw ʿaḍḍū ʿalaykumul-anāmila minal-ghayẓ, qul mūtū bighayẓikum, innallāha ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr
In tamsaskum ḥasanatun tasuʾhum, waʾin tuṣibkum sayyiʾatuy yafraḥū bihā, waʾin taṣbirū watattaqū lā yaḍurrukum kayduhum shayʾā, innallāha bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭ
Waʾidh ghadawta min ahlika tubawwiʾul-muʾminīna maqāʿida lil-qitāl, wallāhu samīʿun ʿalīm
Idh hammaṭ ṭāʾifatāni minkum an tafshalā wallāhu waliyyuhumā, waʿalallāhi falyatawakkalil-muʾminūn
Walaqad naṣarakumullāhu bibadriw waʾantum adhillah, fattaqullāha laʿallakum tashkurūn
Idh taqūlu lil-muʾminīna alay yakfiyakum ay yumiddakum rabbukum bithalāthati ālāfim minal-malāʾikati munzalīn
Balā in taṣbirū watattaqū wayaʾtūkum min fawrihim hādhā yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati ālāfim minal-malāʾikati musawwimīn
Wamā jaʿalahullāhu illā bushrā lakum walitaṭmaʾinna qulūbukum bih, waman-naṣru illā min ʿindillāhil-ʿazīzil-ḥakīm
Liyaqṭaʿa ṭarafam minal-ladhīna kafarū aw yakbitahum fayanqalibū khāʾibīn
Laysa laka minal-amri shayʾun aw yatūba ʿalayhim aw yuʿadhdhibahum faʾinnahum ẓālimūn
Walillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, yaghfiru limay yashāʾu wayuʿadhdhibu may yashāʾ, wallāhu ghafūrur raḥīm
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā taʾkulur-ribā aḍʿāfam muḍāʿafah, wattaqullāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn
Wattaqun-nāral-latī uʿiddat lil-kāfirīn
Waʾaṭīʿullāha war-rasūla laʿallakum turḥamūn
Wasāriʿū ilā maghfiratim mir rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhas-samāwātu wal-arḍu uʿiddat lil-muttaqīn
Al-ladhīna yunfiqūna fis-sarrāʾi waḍ-ḍarrāʾi wal-kāẓimīnal-ghayẓa wal-ʿāfīna ʿanin-nās, wallāhu yuḥibbul-muḥsinīn
Wal-ladhīna idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan aw ẓalamū anfusahum dhakarullāha fastaghfarū lidhunūbihim, wamay yaghfirudh-dhunūba illallāh, walam yuṣirrū ʿalā mā faʿalū wahum yaʿlamūn
Ulāʾika jazāʾuhum maghfiratum mir rabbihim wajannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā, waniʿma ajrul-ʿāmilīn
Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun fasīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-mukadhdhibīn
Hādhā bayānul lin-nāsi wahudaw wamawʿiẓatul lil-muttaqīn
Walā tahinū walā taḥzanū waʾantumul-aʿlawna in kuntum muʾminīn
Iy yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massal-qawma qarḥum mithluh, watilkal-ayyāmu nudāwiluhā baynan-nās, waliyaʿlamallāhul-ladhīna āmanū wayattakhidha minkum shuhadāʾ, wallāhu lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn
Waliyumaḥḥiṣallāhul-ladhīna āmanū wayamḥaqal-kāfirīn
Am ḥasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata walammā yaʿlamillāhul-ladhīna jāhadū minkum wayaʿlamaṣ-ṣābirīn
Walaqad kuntum tamannawnal-mawta min qabli an talqawh, faqad raʾaytumūhu waʾantum tanẓurūn
Wamā muḥammadun illā rasūl, qad khalat min qablihir-rusul, afaʾim māta aw qutilanqalabtum ʿalā aʿqābikum, wamay yanqalib ʿalā ʿaqibayhi falay yaḍurrallāha shayʾā, wasayajzillāhush-shākirīn
Wamā kāna linafsin an tamūta illā biʾidhnillāhi kitābam muʾajjalā, wamay yurid thawābad-dunyā nuʾtihī minhā, wamay yurid thawābal-ākhirati nuʾtihī minhā, wasanajzish-shākirīn
Wakaʾayyim min nabiyyin qātala maʿahū ribbiyyūna kathīr, famā wahanū limā aṣābahum fī sabīlillāhi wamā ḍaʿufū wamastakānū, wallāhu yuḥibbuṣ-ṣābirīn
Wamā kāna qawlahum illā an qālū rabbanaghfir lanā dhunūbanā waʾisrāfanā fī amrinā wathabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn
Faʾātāhumullāhu thawābad-dunyā waḥusna thawābil-ākhirah, wallāhu yuḥibbul-muḥsinīn
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū in tuṭīʿul-ladhīna kafarū yaruddūkum ʿalā aʿqābikum fatanqalibū khāsirīn
Balillāhu mawlākum, wahuwa khayrun-nāṣirīn
Sanulqī fī qulūbil-ladhīna kafarur-ruʿba bimā ashrakū billāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānā, wamaʾwāhumun-nār, wabiʾsa mathwaẓ-ẓālimīn

Walaqad ṣadaqakumullāhu waʿdahū idh taḥussūnahum biʾidhnih, ḥattā idhā fashiltum watanāzaʿtum fil-amri waʿaṣaytum mim baʿdi mā arākum mā tuḥibbūn, minkum may yurīdud-dunyā waminkum may yurīdul-ākhirah, thumma ṣarafakum ʿanhum liyabtaliyakum, walaqad ʿafā ʿankum, wallāhu dhū faḍlin ʿalal-muʾminīn
Idh tuṣʿidūna walā talwūna ʿalā aḥadiw war-rasūlu yadʿūkum fī ukhrākum faʾathābakum ghammam bighammil likaylā taḥzanū ʿalā mā fātakum walā mā aṣābakum, wallāhu khabīrum bimā taʿmalūn

Thumma anzala ʿalaykum mim baʿdil-ghammi amanatan nuʿāsay yaghshā ṭāʾifatam minkum waṭāʾifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yaẓunnūna billāhi ghayral-ḥaqqi ẓannal-jāhiliyyah, yaqūlūna hal lanā minal-amri min shayʾ, qul innal-amra kullahū lillāh, yukhfūna fī anfusihim mā lā yubdūna lak, yaqūlūna law kāna lanā minal-amri shayʾum mā qutilnā hāhunā, qul law kuntum fī buyūtikum labarazal-ladhīna kutiba ʿalayhimul-qatlu ilā maḍājiʿihim, waliyabtaliyallāhu mā fī ṣudūrikum waliyumaḥḥiṣa mā fī qulūbikum, wallāhu ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr
Innal-ladhīna tawallaw minkum yawmal-taqal-jamʿāni innamastazallahumush-shayṭānu bibaʿḍi mā kasabū, walaqad ʿafallāhu ʿanhum, innallāha ghafūrun ḥalīm

Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā takūnū kal-ladhīna kafarū waqālū liʾikhwānihim idhā ḍarabū fil-arḍi aw kānū ghuzzal law kānū ʿindanā mā mātū wamā qutilū, liyajʿalallāhu dhālika ḥasratan fī qulūbihim, wallāhu yuḥyī wayumīt, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr
Walaʾin qutiltum fī sabīlillāhi aw muttum lamaghfiratum minallāhi waraḥmatun khayrum mimmā yajmaʿūn
Walaʾim muttum aw qutiltum laʾilallāhi tuḥsharūn

Fabimā raḥmatim minallāhi linta lahum, walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓal-qalbi lanfaḍḍū min ḥawlik, faʿfu ʿanhum wastaghfir lahum washāwirhum fil-amr, faʾidhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalallāh, innallāha yuḥibbul-mutawakkilīn
Iy yanṣurkumullāhu falā ghāliba lakum, waʾiy yakhdhulkum faman dhal-ladhī yanṣurukum mim baʿdih, waʿalallāhi falyatawakkalil-muʾminūn
Wamā kāna linabiyyin ay yaghull, wamay yaghlul yaʾti bimā ghalla yawmal-qiyāmah, thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsim mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓlamūn
Afamanittabaʿa riḍwānallāhi kamam bāʾa bisakhaṭim minallāhi wamaʾwāhu jahannam, wabiʾsal-maṣīr
Hum darajātun ʿindallāh, wallāhu baṣīrum bimā yaʿmalūn
Laqad mannallāhu ʿalal-muʾminīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlam min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihī wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumul-kitāba wal-ḥikmah, waʾin kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālim mubīn
Awalammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum mithlayhā qultum annā hādhā, qul huwa min ʿindi anfusikum, innallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
Wamā aṣābakum yawmal-taqal-jamʿāni fabiʾidhnillāhi waliyaʿlamal-muʾminīn

Waliyaʿlamal-ladhīna nāfaqū, waqīla lahum taʿālaw qātilū fī sabīlillāhi awidfaʿū, qālū law naʿlamu qitālal lattabaʿnākum, hum lil-kufri yawmaʾidhin aqrabu minhum lil-īmān, yaqūlūna biʾafwāhihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim, wallāhu aʿlamu bimā yaktumūn
Alladhīna qālū liʾikhwānihim waqaʿadū law aṭāʿūnā mā qutilū, qul fadraʾū ʿan anfusikumul-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīn
Walā taḥsabannal-ladhīna qutilū fī sabīlillāhi amwātā, bal aḥyāʾun ʿinda rabbihim yurzaqūn
Fariḥīna bimā ātāhumullāhu min faḍlihī wayastabshirūna bil-ladhīna lam yalḥaqū bihim min khalfihim allā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
Yastabshirūna biniʿmatim minallāhi wafaḍl, waʾannallāha lā yuḍīʿu ajral-muʾminīn
Alladhīnastajābū lillāhi war-rasūli mim baʿdi mā aṣābahumul-qarḥ, lilladhīna aḥsanū minhum wattaqaw ajrun ʿaẓīm
Alladhīna qāla lahumun-nāsu innan-nāsa qad jamaʿū lakum fakhshawhum fazādahum īmānā, waqālū ḥasbunallāhu waniʿmal-wakīl
Fanqalabū biniʿmatim minallāhi wafaḍlil lam yamsashum sūʾuw wattabaʿū riḍwānallāh, wallāhu dhū faḍlin ʿaẓīm
Innamā dhālikumush-shayṭānu yukhawwifu awliyāʾah, falā takhāfūhum wakhāfūni in kuntum muʾminīn
Walā yaḥzunkal-ladhīna yusāriʿūna fil-kufr, innahum lay yaḍurrullāha shayʾā, yurīdullāhu allā yajʿala lahum ḥaẓẓan fil-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm
Innal-ladhīnashtarawul-kufra bil-īmāni lay yaḍurrullāha shayʾā, walahum ʿadhābun alīm
Walā yaḥsabannal-ladhīna kafarū annamā numlī lahum khayrul liʾanfusihim, innamā numlī lahum liyazdādū ithmā, walahum ʿadhābum muhīn

Mā kānallāhu liyadharal-muʾminīna ʿalā mā antum ʿalayhi ḥattā yamīzal-khabītha minaṭ-ṭayyib, wamā kānallāhu liyuṭliʿakum ʿalal-ghaybi walākinnallāha yajtabī mir rusulihī may yashāʾ, faʾāminū billāhi warusulih, waʾin tuʾminū watattaqū falakum ajrun ʿaẓīm

Walā yaḥsabannal-ladhīna yabkhalūna bimā ātāhumullāhu min faḍlihī huwa khayral lahum, bal huwa sharrul lahum, sayuṭawwaqūna mā bakhilū bihī yawmal-qiyāmah, walillāhi mīrāthus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna khabīr
Laqad samiʿallāhu qawlal-ladhīna qālū innallāha faqīruw wanaḥnu aghniyāʾ, sanaktubu mā qālū waqatlahumul-ambiyāʾa bighayri ḥaqqiw wanaqūlu dhūqū ʿadhābal-ḥarīq
Dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum waʾannallāha laysa biẓallāmil lil-ʿabīd

Alladhīna qālū innallāha ʿahida ilaynā allā nuʾmina lirasūlin ḥattā yaʾtiyanā biqurbānin taʾkuluhun-nār, qul qad jāʾakum rusulum min qablī bil-bayyināti wabil-ladhī qultum falima qataltumūhum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
Faʾin kadhdhabūka faqad kudhdhiba rusulum min qablika jāʾū bil-bayyināti waz-zuburi wal-kitābil-munīr
Kullu nafsin dhāʾiqatul-mawt, waʾinnamā tuwaffawna ujūrakum yawmal-qiyāmah, faman zuḥziḥa ʿanin-nāri waʾudkhilal-jannata faqad fāz, wamal-ḥayātud-dunyā illā matāʿul-ghurūr
Latublawunna fī amwālikum waʾanfusikum, walatasmaʿunna minal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba min qablikum waminal-ladhīna ashrakū adhan kathīrā, waʾin taṣbirū watattaqū faʾinna dhālika min ʿazmil-umūr
Waʾidh akhadhallāhu mīthāqal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba latubayyinunnahū lin-nāsi walā taktumūnah, fanabadhūhu warāʾa ẓuhūrihim washtaraw bihī thamanan qalīlā, fabiʾsa mā yashtarūn
Lā taḥsabannal-ladhīna yafraḥūna bimā ataw wayuḥibbūna ay yuḥmadū bimā lam yafʿalū falā taḥsabannahum bimafāzatim minal-ʿadhāb, walahum ʿadhābun alīm
Walillāhi mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
Inna fī khalqis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakhtilāfil-layli wan-nahāri laʾāyātil liʾulil-albāb
Al-ladhīna yadhkurūnallāha qiyāmaw waquʿūdaw waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilā, subḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāban-nār
Rabbanā innaka man tudkhilin-nāra faqad akhzaytah, wamā liẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār
Rabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādiyay yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū birabbikum faʾāmannā, rabbanā faghfir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiʾātinā watawaffanā maʿal-abrār
Rabbanā waʾātinā mā waʿattanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād

Fastajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilim minkum min dhakarin aw unthā, baʿḍukum mim baʿḍ, fal-ladhīna hājarū waʾukhrijū min diyārihim waʾūdhū fī sabīlī waqātalū waqutilū laʾukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim walaʾudkhilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār, thawābam min ʿindillāh, wallāhu ʿindahū ḥusnuth-thawāb
Lā yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhīna kafarū fil-bilād
Matāʿun qalīl, thumma maʾwāhum jahannam, wabiʾsal-mihād
Lākinil-ladhīnattaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulam min ʿindillāh, wamā ʿindallāhi khayrul lil-abrār

Waʾinna min ahlil-kitābi lamay yuʾminu billāhi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna lillāhi lā yashtarūna biʾāyātillāhi thamanan qalīlā, ulāʾika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, innallāha sarīʿul-ḥisāb
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanuṣbirū waṣābirū warābiṭū, wattaqullāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn
